title: Compact upgrade briefs and channel snippet library for customer communications
creator: Alexandra Rivera
description:
Purpose: Create a lightweight, re-usable set of customer-facing upgrade briefs and channel-specific snippet library intended for all upgrade paths (minor, major, and LTS). These deliverables must let product, support, and account teams rapidly assemble tailored comms for: hosted API users, Dedicated customers (reserved capacity), and Private/VPC customers.

Deliverables:
- One-page "compact brief" template (short change summary, migration highlights, immediate actions, rollback plan) for customer emails and in-app banners.
- Channel snippet library with 30+ short copy variants: email subject lines, preheader text, in-app banner copy (2-line and 3-line), release-notes intro paragraph, support reply templates, and knowledge base headers.
- Enterprise annexes: checklist for dedicated/private customers (DB schema or config changes, KMS/HSM considerations, scheduled maintenance windows), suggested SLAs for staged rollouts, and tailored migration guidance for LTS customers.
- Guardrail messaging for rollout gates: what to say when rollout is paused, when canary detected regressions, and post-rollback customer notification templates.
- A single canonical JSON representation of each snippet and brief so teams can programmatically pull the right copy for automation (Zendesk macros, Intercom, in-app banner engine).

Acceptance criteria:
1) 1 canonical compact brief template in JSON + 3 filled examples covering a minor patch (non-breaking), a major version with schema changes, and an LTS migration with deprecation windows.
2) 30+ distinct snippet variants stored in JSON, tagged by channel, customer type (hosted/dedicated/private), urgency (informational/action-required), and tone (formal/concise/friendly).
3) Enterprise annex checklist validated by Solutions Engineering and Security (KMS notes).
4) Rollout gate templates for pause/fail/rollback reviewed and approved by Support and Legal.
5) Documentation page in the Console help center drafted and linked in the PR.

Notes, risks and constraints:
- Must avoid promising specific timeline commitments for Dedicated/private customers unless SRE and sales sign-off on maintenance windows.
- LTS customers often require longer deprecation notices and additional migration support; ensure migration examples include opt-out + extended support phrasing.
- Translate the most common 6 subject lines and 6 banner variants into localized English variants for EU customers (UK, IE) as a pilot.

Progress updates:
- 2026-02-12: Kickoff with Solutions Engineering and Support; gathered field requests for migration checklist items.
- 2026-02-18: Drafted compact brief schema and initial snippet taxonomy; created JSON schema for snippet metadata.
- 2026-02-25: Legal reviewed preliminary guardrail messaging; suggested softening of SLA language.
- 2026-03-02: Filled first example (minor patch) and started validation with Support team.

Open tasks:

- Finalize 30+ snippet variants and run a 1-week trial using Intercom canned responses.
- Get Solutions Engineering sign-off on enterprise annex checklist by 2026-03-09.
- Draft Console help page and open PR for doc-review.
